| Moderate | Zone 1 | below LT1 | \< 5.1 | \> 11:50 | \< 119 | \< 9.9 | – |
|  | Zone 2 |  | 5.1–6.8 | 8:52–11:50 | 119–130 | 9.9–10.4 | \< 1.7 |
| Heavy | Zone 3 | LT1 to LT2 | 6.8–14.0 | 4:16–8:52 | 130–178 | 10.4–16.1 | 1.7–5.5 |
| Severe | Zone 4 | above LT2 | 14.0–15.0 | 4:00–4:16 | 178–183 | 16.1–18.0 | 5.5–6.9 |
|  | Zone 5 |  | \> 15.0 | \< 4:00 | \> 183 | \> 18.0 | \> 6.9 |

## Predicted performance

What the threshold predicts for a race, from the equations of Roecker et
al. 1998 and Sjodin & Jacobs 1981.

| Race          | From the threshold    | Expected time | 95 of 100 athletes |
|---------------|-----------------------|---------------|--------------------|
| 5 km          | IAT at 11.5 km/h      | 21:15         | 18:54 to 24:15     |
| 10 km         | IAT at 11.5 km/h      | 47:00         | 41:04 to 54:56     |
| Half marathon | IAT at 11.5 km/h      | 1:50:56       | 1:35:39 to 2:12:03 |
| Marathon      | IAT at 11.5 km/h      | 4:02:54       | 3:30:20 to 4:47:24 |
| Marathon      | OBLA 4.0 at 12.6 km/h | 4:09:14       | 3:38:55 to 4:49:18 |

How to read it: athletes with this threshold ran the 5 km in 21:15 on
average; 95 of 100 of them took between 18:54 and 24:15.

## What to double-check

8 of 10 checks of the data passed.

|  |  |  |
|----|----|----|
| i | Stages | 6 stages: the LTP fit has 6 parameters, so no degrees of freedom are left and LTP can move a lot with one stage (at least 8 stages are better); the fitted curves rest on few points too. |
| ! | LT1 | 31% of peak apart (5 methods, Bsln + 0.5 6.8 to Log-log 11.8): the choice of LT1 decides the zones, so look at the overview before choosing. |

## The test

Treadmill at 2% grade, 3-min stages of +2 km/h from 6 km/h, earlobe
capillary blood (simulated test in lactate_tests, on the protocol of
Roecker et al. 1998)

| Stage | Intensity (km/h) | Lactate (mmol/L) | Heart rate (bpm) | RPE (6‑20) |

| 4     | 12.0             | 3.60             | 167              | 13         |
| 5     | 14.0             | 5.30             | 178              | 16         |
| 6     | 16.0             | 8.70             | 187              | 20         |
